description: This file defines the GameScreen widget for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe game. It builds the main game interface, including app bar, game mode toggle, status banner, player info chips, game board, restart/reset buttons, and scoreboard.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that composes the main UI for the Tic Tac Toe game, including game controls, info, and scoreboard.

classes.name: _StatusBanner
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays dynamic status messages within an animated container, styled with shadows and icons.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the GameScreen, assembling various UI components and handling interactions.

methods.name: _StatusBanner.build
methods.description: Builds the status banner with animated styles and status text.
